provider_receipt.summary: Review found four named defects: (1) src/lib.rs:56-89 MemoryStore::store serializes each MemoryRecord and immediately discards it, so scan_vault provides no claimed persistent-memory integration; (2) src/lib.rs:13-25 accepts a legacy frontmatter shape that is incompatible with the active ingestion contract in docs/human-knowledge-ingestion-contract.md:71-94, omitting authority, privacy, provenance, review, and lifecycle fields while requiring numeric rather than low/medium/high confidence; (3) src/lib.rs:184-192 resolves slash-containing wikilinks without containment validation, allowing ../ traversal outside the vault and exposing external paths when they exist; (4) src/lib.rs:110-114 silently discards WalkDir errors, allowing incomplete scans to be reported as successful. The durable evidence establishes only a clean tree and does not support functional, security, privacy, or contract-compliance completion.
